title: Bucket Enchantments
description: Adds the enchantments Source and Void to buckets. A part of Curse and Enchantment Extension.
body: ![header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2lrWPPix/images/39e57a248722b71183f4e1659f8d2c959a8e81e4.png) ___ Standalone from [Curse & Enchantment Extension](https://modrinth.com/datapack/enchantment-extension), which compliments [Curse & Enchantment Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/datapack/enchantment-overhaul) ___ This pack adds two new enchantments to bucket: ## Source Grants the enchanted water bucket infinite water. ## Void Makes the bucket unable to store water, an inverted source. | | | |---|---| | [](https://modrinth.com/datapack/shulker-box-enchantments) | [](https://modrinth.com/datapack/elytra-enchantments) | | [](https://modrinth.com/datapack/enchantment-extension) | [](https://modrinth.com/datapack/enchantment_overhaul) |
